newsitem.title: USA: NCI Building sees Q2 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: NCI Building sees Q2 below expectations.

text.p: NCI Building Systems Inc said on Monday it expects its earnings for the second quarter ended April 30 to be below Wall Street estimates, since weather during the period delayed shipments.

Securities analysts had expected the company to earn about $0.74 a share for the period, according to First Call's consensus of earnings estimates. NCI expects revenues of $90 million in the second quarter, it said.
In last year's second quarter, the company earned $0.60 a share, or $5.05 million, on sales of $72.2 million.
